tasks.title: Compose e2e runs the rendered probe snippets within 10000 ms and CI requires the result
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Task cut, Behavior item 3 (all ten scenario steps, Isolation of the snippets, all three One-interval waits, and parent cleanup) and item 4; all Checks and Completion evidence; Acceptance evidence 3, Counterexamples Compose project and One interval (deploy), Rollout order and Security impact CI/secret handling. Use T1 library/prefills and merged api/console main. Add exact pre-id HTML decoding and literal entity tests, the console-probes scenario before persistence, published-image skip, CI gate and root docs. Stack commands retain caller COMPOSE_FILE/COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME; every rendered snippet command including rotation and cleanup runs through snippet_run in the mktemp directory with the five specified COMPOSE_* variables removed, plus explicit -p/-f on Compose commands. Observe independent GET /locations results by the literal t0+10000 deadline with bounded requests for docker launch, Compose launch and rotation; a poll begun in time but completed late never passes.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; snippet decoding selects the requested pre id and matches literal decoded strings for &, <, >, " and '. Existing setup regression suite still passes unchanged with 0 secret occurrences in output.

exit 0 for every tracked JSON file.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; the remaining checks of the touched CI lint job pass. Docker Compose version is at least 2.23 as required by that job.
exit 0; repository lint/workflow validation, CLI typecheck and full CLI tests remain green.

exit 0 with sibling main revisions including this spec's merged api/console changes. Output contains ==> All checks passed, the three prefixes ok: docker run probe e2e-run reported within 10 s (, ok: compose probe e2e-compose reported within 10 s (, ok: rotated probe e2e-run reported within 10 s ( (each ending with measured <n> ms)), and exact ok: console probe locations; existing ok: manual incident privacy remains. Fresh TOTP-owner setup uses T1 library; actual rendered commands run on pulse-e2e_default via snippet_run, removing COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME, COMPOSE_FILE, COMPOSE_PROFILES, COMPOSE_ENV_FILES and COMPOSE_PATH_SEPARATOR in a temporary directory without .env. e2e-run first shows Awaiting first result, then Reporting. All 3 timed waits use host now_ms from LC_ALL=C EPOCHREALTIME, deadline=t0+10000, each curl --connect-timeout and --max-time=min(2000,left) ms in fractional seconds, and require the independent /locations answer to hold lastResultAt>=t0 AND finish with t_done<=deadline; sleeps are at most min(1000,remaining) ms. A poll starting at t0+9500 and finishing at t0+10300 fails, including for Compose and rotation; a hung poll is bounded by the deadline. After each launch, rotation restart and cleanup the stack probe id equals the pre-launch docker compose ps -q probe reading, or FAIL: the snippet touched the pulse-e2e probe. Exactly 1 running container has the snippet Compose project label. Rotation checks both old/new /probe/checks=200, updates the env file, executes the shown recreation commands and compares the new container env without printing it; revoke gives /probe/checks=401 and keeps location history. Both created secrets and the rotated secret have 0 hits in output, API/console logs and console DB files. Success and failure traps remove snippet containers/project via snippet_run and explicit -p/-f, then the work directory, before parent network teardown; bases are recorded as soon as shown.

acceptance.command: export COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=pulse-e2e; snippet_run "docker compose -p '$COMPOSE_BASE' -f '$COMPOSE_BASE.compose.yaml' config"; (cd "$work" && docker compose -f "$COMPOSE_BASE.compose.yaml" config)
acceptance.expected: Run before CI in the scenario shell with snippet_run/work initialized and COMPOSE_BASE set to the base read from the rendered page. The isolated explicit-project config prints name: <that base>; the second config, without -p and without snippet_run, prints the literal name: pulse-e2e. Record both secret-free outputs in the PR. These are config-only calls, never launches; every actual snippet launch/restart/cleanup uses snippet_run and explicit -p/-f.

exit 0 on the unchanged full published-image setup; literal skip: console probe locations (published images) and ==> All checks passed are printed, and the skipped scenario performs 0 console token mutations or snippet launches.

acceptance.command: gh pr checks && gh pr view --json body --jq .body
acceptance.expected: CI lint and e2e-dev pass; lint includes bash e2e/snippet.test.sh and e2e-dev greps the exact ok: console probe locations line. PR lists all 4 new ok lines with elapsed ms for all 3 waits, independent service revision SHAs printed by CI, both Compose config isolation outputs, full compatibility and check results, with 0 secrets. Security checklist cites evidence for executing rendered commands only via snippet_run in the throwaway directory, explicit Compose project/file selection, unchanged stack probe id and exactly 1 snippet-project container, bounded requests and completed observations within 10000 ms, shell/YAML decoding, token/log/database secrecy and cleanup on success and failure before parent teardown. README and AGENTS describe the scenario, decoder test command and CI gate; T1 dev README describes the prefills.
